concerns: Two KJV quotes use a mid-quote ellipsis ('...') to elide a clause -- ElevenLabs v3 can read '...' as a long trailing pause rather than a smooth join; worth a quick listen on synth to confirm it doesn't sound like the widow/Jesus trail off mid-thought.
Narration runs ~210 words; at a likely ~59-61s target this needs a meaningful atempo speed-up on synth -- watch for the single-stage 2.0x atempo cap this project has hit before on longer pieces.

The closing line shifts from third-person narration ('God went to the one...') to direct second-person address ('your barrel', 'He needs it open') -- this is an intentional CTA voice shift, not a tagging defect, flagged only so it isn't mistaken for an inconsistency.
